001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.command;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.CommonUtil;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
005import lombok.Builder;
006import lombok.Data;
007import lombok.Singular;
008import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
009import net.kyori.adventure.text.format.NamedTextColor;
010import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
011import org.jetbrains.annotations.ApiStatus;
012import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
013import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
014
015import java.lang.reflect.Method;
016import java.util.List;
017import java.util.function.Function;
018import java.util.function.Supplier;
019
020/**
021 * Builds a CommandContainer that can be registered into CommandManager.
022 *
023 * @author Ghost_chu
024 */
025@Data
026@Builder
027public class CommandContainer {
028
029  @NotNull
030  private CommandHandler<?> executor;
031
032  private boolean hidden; // Hide from help, tabcomplete
033  /*
034    E.g you can use the command when having quickshop.removeall.self or quickshop.removeall.others permission
035  */
036  @Singular
037  private List<String> selectivePermissions;
038  @Singular
039  private List<String> permissions; // E.g quickshop.unlimited
040  @NotNull
041  private String prefix; // E.g /quickshop <prefix>
042  @Nullable
043  private Function<@NotNull String, @Nullable Component> description; // Will show in the /quickshop help, provide an arg that pass a player locale code
044
045  private boolean disabled; //Set command is disabled or not.
046  @Nullable
047  private Supplier<Boolean> disabledSupplier; //Set command is disabled or not.
048  @Nullable
049  private Supplier<Component> disablePlaceholder; //Set the text shown if command disabled
050  @Nullable
051  private Function<@Nullable CommandSender, @NotNull Component> disableCallback; //Set the callback that should return a text to shown
052
053  private Class<?> executorType;
054
055  /**
056   * Gets the text should be shown while command was disabled.
057   *
058   * @param sender the sender
059   *
060   * @return the text
061   */
062  public final @NotNull Component getDisableText(@NotNull final CommandSender sender) {
063
064    if(this.getDisableCallback() != null) {
065      return this.getDisableCallback().apply(sender);
066    } else if(this.getDisablePlaceholder() != null && !CommonUtil.isEmptyComponent(this.getDisablePlaceholder().get())) {
067      return this.getDisablePlaceholder().get();
068    } else {
069      return Component.empty().color(NamedTextColor.GRAY).append(QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getTextManager().of(sender, "command.feature-not-enabled").forLocale());
070    }
071  }
072
073  @ApiStatus.Internal
074  @NotNull
075  public Class<?> getExecutorType() {
076
077    if(executorType == null) {
078      bakeExecutorType();
079    }
080    return executorType;
081  }
082
083  @ApiStatus.Internal
084  public void bakeExecutorType() {
085
086    for(final Method declaredMethod : getExecutor().getClass().getMethods()) {
087      if("onCommand".equals(declaredMethod.getName()) || "onTabComplete".equals(declaredMethod.getName())) {
088        if(declaredMethod.getParameterCount() != 3 || declaredMethod.isSynthetic() || declaredMethod.isBridge()) {
089          continue;
090        }
091        executorType = declaredMethod.getParameterTypes()[0];
092        return;
093      }
094    }
095    executorType = Object.class;
096  }
097}
